headlines.description: Aston Villa piled the pressure on big-spending Tottenham and Roberto De Zerbi with a 3-2 away victory to claim a first win in the Premier League this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drab Tottenham fall to Aston Villa defeat

headlines.description: Abdul Fatawu's dismissal after being shown a second yellow card for diving capped a frustrating afternoon for Ipswich in their 1-0 defeat at Everton.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barry strikes for Everton to sink 10-man Ipswich

headlines.description: Hull's unbeaten start to life in the Premier League came to an end with a 2-1 defeat to Newcastle at St James' Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newcastle strike early, end Hull's unbeaten record

headlines.description: Arsenal's 100% start to their Premier League title defence ended in emphatic fashion as Brighton secured a stunning 3-0 win against Mikel Arteta's dumbstruck side.
headlines.shortLinkText: Champions Arsenal battered by brilliant Brighton

headlines.description: Jay DaSilva fired Coventry to their first Premier League win in 25 years as they beat Nottingham Forest 1-0 in another game mired by VAR controversy.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coventry claim first PL win of season at Forest

headlines.description: Brian Brobbey scored a hat trick in a losing cause as Manchester City maintained their 100% Premier League start with a frantic 5-3 win over Sunderland.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man City down Sunderland in eight-goal thriller

headlines.description: Leeds and Crystal Palace battle to gritty goalless draw
headlines.shortLinkText: Leeds and Palace battle to gritty goalless draw

headlines.description: Alexander Isak's second-half strike secured Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola all three points on his return to the Vitality Stadium in a 1-0 victory over his old club Bournemouth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Iraola's Liverpool triumph on Bournemouth return

headlines.description: Wrexham secured a smash-and-grab 2-1 victory against wasteful Southampton courtesy of Keven Schlotterbeck's late own goal.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wrexham beat Southampton after last-gasp own goal

events.name: Preston North End at Queens Park Rangers
West Bromwich Albion at Wolverhampton Wanderers
